name: EU GDPR: AI data protection / AI 数据保护 (draft)
description: Selected AI processing accountability evidence and manual privacy review. Redaction does not establish lawful processing or anonymous data.

sources.title: EDPB small business guide: Be compliant

limitations: Unreviewed selected EU GDPR controls; not full GDPR, UK GDPR, national law or sectoral compliance.
Scope and conditional DPIA/automated-decision triggers are assessment assertions requiring qualified review. Missing triggers remain unknown; a false assertion is not a legal exemption.
Evidence booleans do not independently verify documents, lawful basis, anonymity or data-subject safeguards. The 30-day freshness limit is local assurance policy, not a statutory retention period.

Does not cover all transparency notices, rights, processor contracts, transfers, breach notification or supervisory consultation. Do not use a detector result as proof of consent, anonymity or legality.

controls.title: Review processing scope and conditional triggers
controls.remediation: Document territorial scope, controller/processor roles, personal-data processing and DPIA/automated-decision triggers.

controls.title: AI processing inventory available
controls.remediation: Reference purposes, data categories, recipients and retention for training and inference.

controls.title: Minimisation assessment record available
controls.remediation: Record necessity and retention tests; include residual leakage and detector limitations where used.

controls.title: Review legal basis and personal-data status
controls.remediation: Review each processing purpose, lawful basis, special-category conditions and any anonymity claim.

controls.title: Review DPIA when required
controls.remediation: Review the impact assessment before the relevant processing, including residual risks and consultation needs.

controls.title: Review significant solely automated decisions
controls.remediation: Review applicability, permitted exceptions and safeguards including meaningful human intervention where required.
